You first reported it at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug**, in #inc-vtg-hartford: "gate kiosks offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant," with both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan.

In the same message you wrote that the guard was "writing trailer numbers on a clipboard." That is the only description of the guard's activity in the channel. The next messages cover other things: Mateo's 10:44 report of six trucks waiting and his login problem, Ruth's 10:45 question, and your 10:47 note that you had emailed the incident text. Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03, when Mateo said the guard checked in trailer 8836. Your 11:08 message confirmed both lanes working as of 11:07.

This comes only from #inc-vtg-hartford. If the postmortem needs the guard's own account or any earlier report, check with the people on site.
